# Third-party components

## osr-emu 0.7.0 — `osr-emu.dist.min.js`
Web-based 3D emulator for open source multi-axis stroker robots (OSR2+, SR6, SSR1).
- Source: https://github.com/ayvasoftware/osr-emu (npm: `osr-emu`)
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 ayvajs — see `osr-emu.LICENSE`
- Unmodified upstream distribution file.

## three.js 0.127.0 (bundled inside osr-emu.dist.min.js)
- Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- License: MIT, Copyright © 2010-2021 three.js authors — see `three.LICENSE`

## 3D device models
The emulator bundle embeds simplified meshes of the OSR2+, SR6 (designs by TempestMAx) and SSR1 devices.
The osr-emu package declares MIT for its contents; the meshes are derived from the respective
open hardware designs, whose own terms may apply if you redistribute this plugin.
